propositions: An acceptance criterion with exact repository path/symbol evidence was incorrectly tagged [operator-attested] and passed plan-review because the evidence-kind detector missed it and det_measurement_provenance's missing provenance-line finding was advisory-only
The completion verifier accepted the laundered tag at face value (per ADR-0043 design) with no deterministic close-path guard to reject code-verifiable ACs wrongly tagged as operator-attested

A new deterministic pre-LLM close-path guard (det_attestation_launder.py + txn.ensure_attested_items_valid) was implemented to block tagged ACs citing repo paths/symbols and missing provenance lines, with precision matchers for test-shaped citations and evidence-introducing words

The fix distinguishes between code-verifiable repo citations (test paths, test symbols, pytest node ids always fire; other code paths fire only with evidence markers) and external attestation events (commit hashes, Gerrit change numbers never fire per ADR-0043 contract)
Mixed-evidence criteria are now handled by coaching the author to split the criterion: untagged for the code-verifiable half, tagged with provenance for the external half
Tagged AC edits stale the signed plan-review attestation, triggering re-review to prevent post-certification retagging as an attestation escape
